In terms of Regulation 30 read with Regulation 31A of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that shareholders of the Company in the 30th Annual General Meeting held on Friday, May 23, 2025, have approved reclassification of Mr. Amit Rathi from Promoter Group Shareholder to Public Shareholder with requisite majority.
Mr. Amit Rathi is now reclassified to Public Category Shareholder with immediate effect and will not be reported as part of the Promoter Group Shareholders in the shareholding pattern that will be filed with the Stock Exchanges under Regulation 31 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, going forward.
